title: Schema-Driven Interfaces: Angio-GUI and V-Cornea GUI
description: Schema-driven graphical interfaces, provenance capture and COMBINE/OMEX run archives for two CompuCell3D models exposed as Vivarium processes: Angio-GUI (integrated, API-driven pattern) and the V-Cornea GUI (decoupled, subprocess-based pattern). Release v1.1.1 accompanying the revised manuscript "Addressing the Usability Gap in In Silico Experiments: Schema-Driven Interfaces and Provenance for Reproducible Simulations"; it contains the example runs in examples/, produced from commit 210b9c3.
